import pandas as pd

file='national_programme_ledger.xlsx'
fe = pd.read_excel(file, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=4)
sal = pd.read_excel(file, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=5)
lookup = pd.read_excel(file, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=3)

# Normalize lookup codes
lookup_codes = set()
for code in lookup['Cost Centre Code'].dropna():
    norm = str(code).strip().lower()
    lookup_codes.add(norm)

def normalize(s):
    if pd.isna(s):
        return ''
    return str(s).strip().lower()

fe['cc_norm'] = fe['Cost Centre'].apply(normalize)
fe['status_norm'] = fe['Posting Status'].apply(normalize)

sal['cc_norm'] = sal['Cost Centre'].apply(normalize)
sal['status_norm'] = sal['Payroll Status'].apply(normalize)

fe_filtered = fe[(fe['status_norm']=='posted') & (fe['cc_norm'].isin(lookup_codes))]
sal_filtered = sal[(sal['status_norm']=='paid') & (sal['cc_norm'].isin(lookup_codes))]

fe_total = fe_filtered['Amount (INR)'].sum()
sal_total = sal_filtered['Gross Salary (INR)'].sum()
combined = fe_total + sal_total

print('fe rows', len(fe_filtered), 'total', fe_total)
print('sal rows', len(sal_filtered), 'total', sal_total)
print('combined', combined)

import pandas as pd
import re

file='national_programme_ledger.xlsx'
fe = pd.read_excel(file, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=4)
sal = pd.read_excel(file, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=5)
lookup = pd.read_excel(file, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=3)

def normalize(s):
    if pd.isna(s):
        return ''
    return str(s).strip().lower()

def parse_amount(v):
    if pd.isna(v):
        return 0
    s = str(v).strip()
    # remove ₹ and commas
    s = s.replace('₹','').replace(',','').strip()
    # handle possible spaces
    s = re.sub(r'["'^'"\\d]', '', s)
    try:
        return int(s)
    except:
        return 0

lookup_codes = set()
for code in lookup['Cost Centre Code'].dropna():
    lookup_codes.add(normalize(code))

fe['cc_norm'] = fe['Cost Centre'].apply(normalize)
fe['status_norm'] = fe['Posting Status'].apply(normalize)
fe['amount_clean'] = fe['Amount (INR)'].apply(parse_amount)

sal['cc_norm'] = sal['Cost Centre'].apply(normalize)
sal['status_norm'] = sal['Payroll Status'].apply(normalize)
sal['salary_clean'] = sal['Gross Salary (INR)'].apply(parse_amount)

fe_filtered = fe[(fe['status_norm']=='posted') & (fe['cc_norm'].isin(lookup_codes))]
sal_filtered = sal[(sal['status_norm']=='paid') & (sal['cc_norm'].isin(lookup_codes))]

fe_total = fe_filtered['amount_clean'].sum()
sal_total = sal_filtered['salary_clean'].sum()
combined = fe_total + sal_total

print('fe rows', len(fe_filtered), 'total', fe_total)
print('sal rows', len(sal_filtered), 'total', sal_total)
print('combined', combined)
PY"
